name: Kasugai Iroha
source:
A first year student in the same class as the protagonist. She is quiet, calm, and gentle. She was in the same class and aviation club with the protagonist in their previous school, even though she was a coward and wouldn't get on the glider. Sweets making is her strong point and she often makes them with tea for the Big Sky club.

[Based on [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/初恋サクラメント]Wikipedia[/url]]
